roads.name: National Forest Development Road 072
words: Curve after curve after curve: 30 in 2.9 miles, about 10 a mile.
Plenty of tight curves among them.
From 3,647 to 4,492 ft, with 850 ft of up and down along the way.
July highs average 86°F.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 1.45 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this assumes 55 mph.

Wooded nearly the whole way.
July highs average 77°F.

roads.name: Pioneer Mountains Scenic Byway
words: Properly twisty: 96 curves in 16.4 miles, about 6 a mile.
The 3 miles at the north end are tamer.
About 1.7 miles in the middle are tamer.
The curves flow straight into one another.

Wooded nearly the whole way.
July highs average 74°F.
